test_title: PYST 38: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pants are shirts.

No shirt is a tie.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pants can never be ties.

II. All ties are pants.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bec0009a71dd4faa810855708a98acc31ccc271eb1cbab6220c04442a4b0b1bf.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pants can never be ties → Follows (because only some pants are shirts and no shirt is a tie, hence all pants can never be ties.)

II. All ties are pants → Does not follow (because only some pants are shirts and no shirt is a tie, hence all ties can never be pants.)

Hence, “Only conclusion I follows”.
